recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot group portrait of three men in urban attire, featuring a central figure in a black leather jacket and oval sunglasses, flanked by two others in a shallow depth-of-field outdoor setting. The composition uses a mix of bold script and serif typography with a distinct 1990s hip-hop aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground with a direct, confrontational gaze.
Secondary figures are positioned behind and to the sides to create depth.
The warm, desaturated background contrasts with the high-contrast black leather textures.
Large-scale script text in the upper right balances the visual weight of the central subject.
coreInvariants: Oval-shaped dark sunglasses on the primary subject.
Heavy leather outerwear in black and brown tones.
Interlocked finger hand gesture in the lower center.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered and scaled to fill 70% of the vertical frame; secondary subjects are scaled smaller and positioned at the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocked hands of the central figure serve as the lower anchor, while the large script title anchors the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central subject's sunglasses, moves down to the hands, then sweeps up to the large script title and down to the bottom-left subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with figures and architectural background elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and deep charcoal from the leather jackets and sunglasses.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white from the undershirts and text elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/ochre used for the title fill and background architectural tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value contrast in the foreground subjects.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight brush script and transitional serif
letterConstructionRules: Title uses a thick, fluid script with a heavy black drop shadow and gold fill.
Subtitle uses a high-contrast serif with rounded terminals.
Text is outlined to ensure legibility against complex backgrounds.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' in the title features an elongated, sweeping descender.
The 'y' has a looped tail that integrates with the baseline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for expressive branding paired with a classic serif for clarity.
graphicDevices: Rectangular advisory-style badge in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, heavy-weight urban script feel.
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of three men in 90s urban fashion (leather jackets, oval sunglasses) standing in front of a blurred industrial stone structure. The central man should have his hands clasped. Use a warm, slightly grainy film aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large gold script title with a thick black outline in the top right. Add a white serif subtitle in the bottom left with a thin black outline. Place a black and white rectangular warning badge in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the title script bold and outlined?
Are the sunglasses oval and dark?
Is the central figure's pose centered with clasped hands?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones, black, and white?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for 90s-appropriate eyewear and clothing textures.
Ensure the script text does not obscure the main subject's face.
Verify the presence of the bottom-right graphic badge.
Confirm the color balance between the gold text and the warm background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group Portrait + Leather Textures + Heavy Script Overlay + Film Grain Filter
